name: Template Exporter
description: Export LXC archives and VM backups for sharing or migration. Uses temporary export clones, guided LXC cleanup, compression choice, filename hints, manifest and checksum output, and optional CT/VM creation after import.

notes.text: Run this tool on the Proxmox host as root.
LXC export can remove net0 and sanitize the container; review the cleanup checklist before proceeding.
Imported .tar.gz files are placed into CT Templates storage so they appear in the Proxmox GUI.
The LXC login header file (/etc/profile.d/00_lxc-details.sh) is preserved during sanitize operations.
Exports run against a temporary clone so the source guest remains usable and unchanged.
Choose clone storage and compression (gzip/zstd) during export.
Exports stop the guest for consistency and use full clones.
Toggle debug output in the menu to see live command output.
Exports show a progress gauge (non-debug) or live foreground output (debug).
Prompts are collected before long-running tasks to avoid hidden dialogs.
